messages:
Alex: Heads up — noticed weird half-close in EU canary WS streams: upstream sends TCP FIN but proxy doesn't emit WS close frame. Repro twice in 30m. :confused:
Jamie: Which route/pool?
Alex: /v1/stream/generate on canary pool (redwood-llama-13b-rc). Proxy log snippet:
```
[proxy] 2025-06-12T10:12:01Z upstream FIN conn=0x2b3f
[proxy] 2025-06-12T10:12:01Z wrote 0 bytes, no ws close frame
[client] keepalive ping recv at +25s
```
Maria: That causes clients to keep the socket open and retry -> reconnect storms. Billing might count resumed tokens twice if resume isn't deduped. :scream:
sre-bot: alert: tcp_fin_no_ws_close (eu-west-1) sampled=5 in 45m
Jamie: Two axis: fix transport at proxy (translate FIN->WS close) and add telemetry/billing safeguards. Which first?
Alex: Proxy translation is low-risk and reversible. We can emit a normal close frame with code 1006 (abnormal) and close. Also add metric streaming.tcp_fin_translated.
Maria: Also add streaming.resume_dedupe_events in billing and make resume idempotent for 15s by (resume_id, last_seq).
Jamie: Console needs a small banner when telemetry diverges: proxy-sampled vs billing-aggregates >5% for a route. Make it pausable.
Alex: I'll open PR for proxy + metric + tests. Plan canary: 3% eu-west traffic for 1h. Rollback flag handy.
Maria: I'll take the rollout and perf checks. Data infra: can you increase sampling alignment during canary?
data-infra: Yup — will align proxy sampling tag to billing pipeline for the window. Also can add a temporary hourly inflate to reduce noise.
Jamie: Add alert: if streaming.tcp_fin_translated spikes >30/min or resume_dedupe_events > 10/min -> auto-pause rollout.
Alex: Adding runbook: how to correlate traces: include trace_id, session_id, resume_id in every span. Posting a short snippet in PR.
Maria: Also file a console ticket to implement the banner and a quick toggle to pause translation per-route.
Alex: Filing GH issues: proxy-translate-fin, billing-resume-dedupe, console-telemetry-banner, runbook. Assigning owners.
sre-bot: created INC-1229 assigned eng-platform.
Alex: I'll start the canary now and drop an update in 30m. :rocket:
Jamie: thx — ping if you need on-call help.
